4.0 is the biggest release of the server so far, built so that every tool's answer is something an agent can trust. All 43 tools now return structured results, several projects can run at once, and new tools cover resources, node moves, project settings and render checks. I replaced the script security scan with a one-time confirmation per project. This release breaks clients written against 3.8.1 in several places, and [Migrating to 4.0](https://github.com/Erodenn/godot-mcp-runtime/blob/v4.0.0/docs/migration-4.0.md) lists every breaking case with its before and after.

## Breaking changes

- **Godot 4.5 or later is required.** Older engines cannot parse the server's GDScript. CI runs on 4.5.1, 4.6.2 and 4.7.2. Bringing back support for older 4.x versions, and expanding it further, is a goal for a future release.
- **`attach_project` and `detach_project` are removed.** Use `run_project({ attach: true })` to attach and `stop_project` to end either kind of session.
- **Every tool returns structured JSON.** All 43 tools declare an `outputSchema` and return `structuredContent`. Tools that answered with a sentence now answer with fields, and some fields were renamed.
- **No more false successes.** Calls that reported success for something that did not happen now return an error or lead with a `warnings` entry. Input that used to be ignored or half applied is refused, including unknown keys, fractional or out-of-range integers, and integer values past 32 bits that a property did not keep; a smaller value its setter changes succeeds with a leading warning.
- **Sessions are per project.** `run_project` on a second project adds a session instead of stopping the first, and runtime tools act on the current session only, never falling back to another. Runtime calls run one at a time; a call that waits 30 seconds returns an error.
- **Scene edits keep what the file held.** Inherited scenes stay inherited, edits inside an instance write only the changed property, uids survive, and `batch_scene_operations` writes only the scenes it changed.
- **Paths are checked more closely.** Paths that escape the project through a link on write, Windows device names and trailing dots are refused, while an in-project `..` and linked read-only folders are now accepted.
- **The script security scan is gone.** The `run_script` tiers, the launch pre-flight scan, strict mode, `.policy.json` audit files and the `GODOT_MCP_STRICT` and `GODOT_MCP_DISABLE_SECURITY` variables are removed; setting either variable now does nothing. The scan was a denylist that kept missing ways a project runs code. What stays is a confirmation the first time a project is launched, and the first time `run_script` targets a project, in each server session. A client without elicitation runs both with one warning on the first call. [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Erodenn/godot-mcp-runtime/blob/v4.0.0/SECURITY.md) names what the server can do to a project and what the prompts do not protect.
- **Smaller changes:** a `simulate_input` action now sends an `InputEventAction`, so `ui_*` actions act on the focused Control; `click_element` refuses a target another Control covers, before pressing anything; `profile_project` takes at most 30 seconds; `list_autoloads` returns one entry per name; `add_autoload` refuses a singleton named like a project `class_name`.

## New

- **Four new tools.** `create_resource` and `set_resource_properties` write `.tres` files, `move_nodes` reparents and reorders scene nodes, and `set_project_setting` writes `project.godot` values. `set_project_setting` sends autoload keys to the autoload tools and refuses values that would leave `project.godot` unloadable.
- **Narrower reads.** `get_ui_elements` takes a `root` subtree, `get_project_files` takes a `subfolder`, and `duplicate_node` takes `copySignals` to drop a copy's connections to outside handlers. `click_element` scrolls a clipped target into view first.
- **`render_movie`** renders a few frames under the engine's movie writer, with no session, and reports whether the scene is blank or animating. It can also keep the frames or a video.
- **Screenshot statistics.** `take_screenshot` reports pixel statistics and a `likelyBlank` verdict, so an agent that cannot see the image can tell a rendered frame from a blank one.
- **Multiple projects at once.** `switch_project` picks the current session, and `check_project` lists every live one.
- **Richer profiling.** Captures report `fps`, slow frames and engine monitors, with opt-in Visual Profiler stages (`visual`), a per-interval `timeline` and up to four `track`ed node properties.
- **Property round trips.** `set_node_properties` and `add_node` can set `metadata/<name>` and typed slash keys like `theme_override_colors/font_color`, and `get_node_properties` reads vectors and packed arrays back in the shapes `set_node_properties` accepts.

## Fixed

- **Results no longer break on project output.** A result travels on its own marked line, so the engine banner or an autoload's prints no longer cause `GDScript returned invalid JSON` (#68).
- **Scene edits are no longer lost or misreported.** This covers edits inside instanced scenes, duplicated instances, signal connections into instances, failed batch saves, and batches that touch a scene and the scenes built from it.
- **Input reaches the game the way a key does.** Actions reach `_input` and `_gui_input` handlers (#70), and projects that raise GDScript warnings to errors now load the bridge and run headless operations (#72).
- **Mouse input lands where the control is drawn.** Click and mouse positions are converted under `canvas_items` stretch, `content_scale_factor`, CanvasLayer and canvas transforms, and `get_ui_elements` reports rects in the same space (#76).
- **Profiling no longer blames the server for a capped frame rate.** The stall check allows for `Engine.max_fps` and the frame delay before it reports a busy server.
- **Slow-starting attaches no longer end early.** Pings a game refuses before its bridge port first accepts a connection no longer count toward giving up, so `run_project({ attach: true })` waits out a slow engine start (#75).
- **Games no longer outlive the server.** Spawned games are killed as a process tree, quit when their server dies, and shutdown waits for edits in progress. On Windows, headless runs no longer paint over your terminal and background games stay hidden.
- **Ignored parameters take effect.** `update_autoload`'s `autoload_path` and `get_ui_elements`'s `visible_only` work, and the autoload tools accept snake_case names.
- **Errors say why.** Failed headless operations end with the engine's last stderr lines and lead with the operation's own reason, and `validate` no longer passes a script with a parse error because of how its path was written.
- **Security.** A `res://` path written with a leading slash could load a script from outside the project on Godot 4.5; it is now refused.
